content.introduction: The United States economic indicators as of October 8, 2026, show Business Confidence at 55.6 points, Manufacturing PMI at 53.9 points, Non Manufacturing PMI at 54.1 points, Services PMI at 54.6 points, Composite PMI at 54.5 points, and Industrial Production at 1.1 percent. The Government Budget deficit is at -5.9 percent of GDP. Consumer Confidence is at 51 points, and Retail Sales MoM is at -0.6 percent. Gross Fixed Capital Formation is at USD 4551 billion. GDP per Capita is USD 67946, and GDP per Capita PPP is USD 76931. Full Year GDP Growth is 2.1 percent. The sources do not provide specific details on the GDP Growth Contribution Consumer Spending and Exports beyond the given percentage points.

The U.S. Census Bureau’s economic indicator surveys provide monthly and quarterly data that are timely, reliable, and offer comprehensive measures of the U.S. economy. These surveys provide a variety of statistics covering construction, housing, international trade, retail trade, wholesale trade, services and manufacturing. The survey data provide measures of the economic activity that allows analysis of economic performance and inform business investment and policy decisions. For information
